newsitem.title: FRANCE: No new consumption measures planned-France's Noyer.
newsitem.headline: No new consumption measures planned-France's Noyer.

text.p: A top aide to Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Thursday the government had no plans for new measures to boost spending.
"There is no plan for incentives for consumer spending," Christian Noyer, head of Arthuis's private office, told an investment seminar.
He had been asked whether the government planned new measures similar to an incentive scheme to encourage people to buy new cars.
Prime Minister Alain Juppe was due to present a tax reform plan later on Thursday, while the government will present a budget for 1997 officially on September 18.
